english.title: Use a motor vehicle with defective steering gear
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when its steering gear was not

(A)_[maintained in good and efficient working order]_
(B)_[properly adjusted]_
(C)_[maintained in good and efficient working order and properly adjusted]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 29 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 41A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale in any other case.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Fixed penalty ticket - one hundred pounds and licence endorsed three penalty points.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
